Canopi| REMOTE (US-Based Preferred) | Senior Software Engineer | Contract | canopi.work

Hey this is Dixon from Canopi, a workforce risk intelligence platform built for ground transportation operators. Our AI engine continuously monitors driver eligibility signals and surfaces real-time alerts before a carrier loses a driver, gets fined, or faces a liability event. We are not a compliance tool. We are the autonomous brain that makes driver risk intelligence possible at scale.

Canopi is a Microsoft for Startups company building entirely on Azure, and is hiring engineers who want to build something that doesn't exist in the market today. We are open to an equity-first engagement while we close our seed round.

Reach out to dixon@canopi.work and mention HN in your email!
